name: Iberia Ignota: Alboleta
summary: The year is 1650. War, religion, insurrections, the kingdom of Spain fights long conflicts on lots of fronts. Triumphs are few and the flow of money out of the country breaks a population used to hunger. In Old Castille, in a valley with an archaic name, rules the la Haya county. The heir, infant Cosme de la Haya, has been assassinated. You have been charged to solve the mystery around his passing in three days. There won't be more chances. Will you be able to solve the case? Would you be able to dig all the secrets of the town before time runs out? Thanks to a mysterious box that's been with you some time, you could be the one with more chances to accomplish the impossible, find the monster that haunts the valley.
